abstract: Semen and blood samples were obtained, at 3-month intervals over 12 to 28 months, from patients who underwent subdiaphragmal radiation after orchidectomy for seminoma testis. Before radiotherapy a mean (+/- SE) semen volume of 4.7 +/- 0.5 ml, a mean sperm count of 44.4 +/- 13.5 x 10(6)/ml, a mean percentage of motile cells of 20.3 +/- 5.2, a mean percentage of morphologically normal spermatozoa of 13.4 +/- 5.4, a mean percentage of swollen sperm of 39.6 +/- 7.4, and a mean serum follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) value of 8.3 +/- 1.2 mIU/ml was found. The mean testicular dose from scatter was 62 +/- 5 cGy (range, 34 to 95 cGy). Sperm counts between 0 and 2.75 x 10(6)/ml were seen at 6.8 +/- 0.6 months and recovery to values greater than 2.25 x 10(6)/ml at 11.8 +/- 0.8 months after the start of radiation. Peak FSH values of 19.2 +/- 1.6 mIU/ml were obtained at 6.7 +/- 0.9 months after the start of irradiation. After recovery mean semen volume was 3.9 +/- 0.4 ml, mean sperm count 34.6 +/- 5.6 x 10(6)/ml, the mean percentage of motile cells 42.5 +/- 6.0, the mean percentage of swollen sperm 58.7 +/- 6.8, and the mean percentage of spermatozoa with normal morphology 23.4 +/- 5.1. Only motility was significantly different (P less than 0.01) from pretreatment values. The elevation of FSH values with time after start of radiotherapy reflected the toxicity to spermatogenesis but no correlation was found between peak FSH levels and scattered radiation dose. Also, neither the time from start of radiotherapy to sperm count nadir or recovery nor the time to peak FSH levels was significantly correlated with radiation dose.
abstract_ja: 精巣摘除後に横隔膜下放射線療法を受けたセミノーマ患者から、12～28か月にわたり3か月ごとに精液および血液検体を採取した。放射線療法開始前の平均（±SE）精液量は4.7±0.5 ml、平均精子数は44.4±13.5×10⁶/ml、平均運動率は20.3±5.2%、平均形態正常精子率は13.4±5.4%、平均膨化精子率は39.6±7.4%、平均血清卵胞刺激ホルモン（FSH）値は8.3±1.2 mIU/mlであった。散乱線による平均精巣線量は62±5 cGy（範囲34～95 cGy）であった。精子数が0～2.75×10⁶/mlとなったのは放射線照射開始後6.8±0.6か月時点で、2.25×10⁶/ml超に回復したのは11.8±0.8か月時点であった。FSHのピーク値19.2±1.6 mIU/mlは照射開始後6.7±0.9か月時点で得られた。回復後の平均精液量は3.9±0.4 ml、平均精子数は34.6±5.6×10⁶/ml、平均運動率は42.5±6.0%、平均膨化精子率は58.7±6.8%、平均正常形態精子率は23.4±5.1%であった。運動率のみが治療前値と比べて有意に異なっていた（P<0.01）。放射線療法開始後のFSH値の経時的上昇は精子形成への毒性を反映していたが、ピークFSH値と散乱線量の間に相関は認められなかった。また、放射線療法開始から精子数の最低値あるいは回復までの期間、およびFSHピークまでの期間のいずれも、照射線量と有意な相関を示さなかった。
